implementedTodos.title: Separate schema-file coverage from schema-sync validation evidence
resolution: The mdpr-skill release verdict now separates schema_contract_files_covered from schema_sync_gate_passed.
schema_sync_gate_passed is proven only from an actual validate-schema-sync command/report with an existing MDPR checkout; otherwise it remains not_evaluated.
scripts/validate_rdd_mdpr_skill_profile.py rejects the stale combined schema_sync_and_shared_contracts constraint and rejects coverage-only schema-sync proof.

implementedTodos.title: Tighten mdpr-skill omitted-path allowlist to remove stale game-project patterns
resolution: The RDD context inventory helper now uses release-profile-specific omitted-path allowlists.
The mdpr-skill allowlist contains generated, cache, build, artifact, CI/tooling, and Python bytecode exclusions only.
scripts/validate_rdd_mdpr_skill_profile.py rejects stale FluxDerby, Unity, Steam, CraftPix, and saves allowlist terms.

runtimeBoundary: MDPR remains the deterministic owner of parsing, layout, rendering, PPTX/PDF output, and validation pass/fail decisions; this cycle only updates RDD evidence classification for mdpr-skill review workflows.
